title: The computational and neural substrates of moral strategies in social decision-making
category_cn: 作者明确提出的理论含义、理论延伸或未来理论工作
verbatim_quote: The low prevalence of pure guilt aversion in our sample may be helpful for improving psychological game theory as it suggests that some guilt-averse behavior in past research may in fact have been motivated by inequity aversion, and that guilt-averse preferences may be context-dependent (e.g., for moral opportunists in our task).
author_claim_cn: 作者指出，样本中纯粹 guilt aversion 的低发生率可能有助于改进心理博弈理论，因为它表明过去研究中的某些 guilt-averse 行为实际上可能由 inequity aversion 驱动，且 guilt-averse 偏好可能是情境依赖的。
theory_or_construct_original_terms: psychological game theory; guilt aversion; inequity aversion
current_theoretical_limit_cn: 心理博弈理论可能未充分区分 guilt aversion 和 inequity aversion 的动机，且未考虑 guilt-averse 偏好的情境依赖性。
proposed_theoretical_move_cn: 通过揭示 guilt-averse 行为可能由 inequity aversion 驱动且具有情境依赖性，扩展心理博弈理论中关于社会偏好的假设。
relationship_or_prediction_to_test_cn: 检验 guilt-averse 行为是否可被 inequity aversion 解释，以及 guilt-averse 偏好如何随情境变化。
